description: Couverture mobile 2G 3G 4G des sites par opérateurs sur le périmètre de la Communauté urbaine de Dunkerque is a dataset listed in Open Data Dunkerque Agglomération, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Autorité de régulation des communications électroniques et des postes (ARCEP). Liste des sites des opérateurs mobiles en France métropolitaine au 30 septembre 2019. Ce jeu de données recense et localise les antennes mobiles des quatre opérateurs et la disponibilité des différentes technologies (2G, 3G, 4G) sur ces sites. Coverage: Dunkirk urban community. The portal files it under Numérique. Its keywords are arcep, téléphonie mobile, telecommunication, operateur, 2G - 3G - 4 G. The portal shows 162 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2020-01-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-dunkerque-agglo-fr-portal.
